hero: In a hospital conference room in Cebu City, a Filipina internal medicine resident points at a projected bar chart comparing two trial arms while a Filipino nephrology fellow and four other young residents in white coats take notes around a long table, lunch boxes pushed aside; midday light through blinds, engaged and friendly mood, no text.

figures.teaches: A relative risk reduction becomes a small absolute difference that patients can weigh.
figures.content: Two 10 x 10 grids of person icons side by side. Left grid 'Placebo, median 2.6 years': 21 icons shaded dark (event). Right grid 'Finerenone': 18 icons shaded dark and 3 icons outlined in green labeled 'spared'. Between them: 'Hazard ratio 0.82' crossed by an arrow to 'Absolute risk reduction 3.3 per 100' and 'NNT about 30'. Below, a harm strip of two rows of 100 dots: 'Stopped drug for hyperkalemia: 0.9% placebo vs 2.3% finerenone'. Footer: 'FIDELIO-DKD, 5,734 randomized; primary outcome: kidney failure, sustained eGFR fall of at least 40%, or renal death.'

figures.teaches: PDSA cycles test one change at a time, and a run chart shows whether the change was followed by a sustained shift.
figures.content: Left: a circular four-part cycle 'Plan (aim, prediction)', 'Do (small test)', 'Study (compare with prediction)', 'Act (adopt, adapt, abandon)'. Right: a run chart, x-axis 'Week 1 to 16', y-axis 'Percent of new starts with timely potassium check (0 to 100)', about 16 points, a horizontal median line, a dashed vertical line at week 6 labeled 'Change 1: pre-printed lab request' and another at week 11 labeled 'Change 2: nearby partner laboratory', points rising and staying above the median after week 6. Footer note: 'Fewer than 20% of published PDSA reports documented iterative cycles fully.'

card: A projected bar chart on a conference room screen with residents' notebooks and coffee cups on the table in front, no text.
